coverageNotes:
Two passes. The first pass had no WebSearch (the shared budget was already spent) and found 6 venues by opening large Nairobi institutional sites directly. This continuation ran 107 WebSearch queries before the shared per-turn search budget ran out again (one more query was refused); the last few checks used WebFetch only. Final file: 20 candidates (15 not in seed) and 15 unverified leads. Most search results for this group were hotel-booking or directory pages. Facts were taken only from club, hotel, university or county pages and news articles; where only directories existed, that is stated in the entry.

NAIROBI. Clubs: Karen Country Club (now members_only, with gym hours from two club pages that disagree), Nairobi Gymkhana (indoor fitness centre and outdoor gym, members only), Public Service Club, Upper Hill (gym on own site; access and hours not readable), Jaffery's Sports Club, Lavington (open to the public per a 2012/2020 Business Daily feature; current status unknown). Nairobi Club, Impala Club, Royal Nairobi Golf Club, Parklands Sports Club, UNON Gigiri, The Boma, Villa Rosa Kempinski, Mövenpick, Swiss-Belinn and Best Western Upper Hill were already recorded by the area groups (nbo-*), so they are not repeated here. Muthaiga Country Club's own site does not mention a gym (lead). Sikh Union, Simba Union, Ruaraka, Railway, Vet Lab, Ngong Racecourse and Kenya Police clubs: no online evidence of a gym. Hotels: Jacaranda (sells individual and corporate memberships; seed match), Sportsview Kasarani (membership form on own site), Serena, Eka, Weston and Safari Park from the first pass. Sarova Stanley/Panafric/Woodlands, Radisson Blu and Frommers pages returned 403. Fairmont Norfolk, Crowne Plaza, Fairview, Tamarind Tree, Ole Sereni (its old domain is now parked), Southern Sun Mayfair, Dusit D2, Laico Regency, Nairobi Safari Club, Hilton Garden Inn and Four Points have gyms on booking sites or own pages, but nothing shows non-guest access. They were left out as guest-only, apart from a few leads. Universities: USIU-Africa, Kenyatta University (seed match; registration by Student ID, Staff PF number or National ID suggests outsiders can join) and Mount Kenya University (Thika; students and staff). Strathmore (503 on every page), Daystar Athi River (site timed out) and KCA (campus not stated) are leads. No gym evidence was found for UoN, JKUAT (staff aerobics only), CUEA, TUK, Multimedia, Riara, Zetech, Co-op or ANU. Staff-only gyms (National Treasury at Bima House, KDF Kahawa Garrison, Kiganjo police college) are not listed because they are closed to the public.

KIAMBU / CENTRAL. Tatu City free public outdoor gym (Capital FM, Oct 2024). Limuru Country Club's site lists hours but no gym. Thika Sports Club, Nyeri Club and Outspan Hotel: no gym evidence (Outspan was reported shut and up for sale). Dedan Kimathi and Karatina universities: nothing found.

LAIKIPIA / RIFT. Nanyuki Sports Club (gym shown only by a 2019 job advert and a directory, so status unknown). Kitale Club gym (club page, hours, 2026). Nakuru Athletic Club, Rift Valley Sports Club, Nakuru Golf Club, Naivasha Sports Club, Eldoret Club (lead, 2014 directory only), Kericho Club and Golf Club (lead) and Kabarak: no first-party gym evidence. Hotel gyms at Merica, Sarova Woodlands, Eka Eldoret, Enashipai, Great Rift Valley Lodge and Boma Inn Eldoret (the last is in rift-west) appear only on booking sites or blocked pages. Egerton, Moi, Laikipia, Kibabii and Embu university pages read do not mention a gym.

NYANZA / WESTERN. JOOTRH hospital gym, Kisumu (county article, Jan 2022, pay-per-visit). Nyanza Club, Kisumu Golf Club and Kisumu Yacht Club: no gym evidence. Acacia Premier and Ciala are in nyanza.json. Golf Hotel Kakamega has no gym on any listing seen. Maseno, MMUST, Kisii and Rongo: nothing found.

COAST. Serena Beach Resort (Shanzu) Maisha Health Club (own page; access unknown), Nyali Golf & Country Club (two golf directories agree it has a gym; no club site; status unknown) and Vipingo Ridge clubhouse gym (resort blog; guests). Mombasa Sports Club lists no gym. Coast Gymkhana (in seed) is documented online only as a cricket ground. The KPA Mbaraki sports club was reported closed for renovation (date unclear). Sarova Whitesands, English Point, PrideInn, Voyager, Diani Reef, Leisure Lodge and Leopard Beach have gyms on booking sites only, and the gyms appear to be guest-only. TUM and Pwani University: nothing found.

EASTERN / NORTH-EASTERN. Only booking-site hotel gyms (Meru Slopes, Gelian Machakos, Maanzoni). No institutional gym with evidence was found in Meru, Embu, Machakos, Kitui, Makueni or any north-eastern county.

Gaps: most club and university gyms in Kenya have no readable web presence, so this group is far from complete. A second pass with search budget should target Strathmore, Daystar, Sarova (blocked to WebFetch), and the country clubs' own sites.
